Hi team,

Quick handoff: Acme Retail (deal ACME-2026-RED-3471) is ready to move from evaluation to implementation. They've selected our hosted embeddings + rerank flow for site search personalization. Sales has sign-off on scope and procurement; Monica, please lead the CS/implementation.

Summary / things we know:
- Estimated document corpus: ~3.8M product + catalog records (see attached acme-current-index-summary.csv).
- Current infra: AWS us-west-2, private VPC, internal search service returns top-500 candidate IDs for rerank.
- Success metrics: NDCG@10 improvement target + business validation on CTR & add-to-cart uplift.
- Timeline target: pilot in staging within 6 weeks, production cutover in ~10 weeks.

Initial asks for kickoff:
1) Security constraints (VPC peering, allowed managed services) from DevOps.
2) Exact export format for their candidate set and sample queries (10–20 queries with human relevancy labels).
3) Agreement on backfill approach and SLA for index rebuilding.

I've attached a short pre-sale technical note that captures what we discussed. Monica—propose a mutual action plan and a tentative kickoff slot. Marissa / Dylan—please flag any immediate red flags (scale, quantization, runtime) and whether we need a dedicated compute pool for the backfill.

Thanks,
Karthik

Folks — quick engineering view from the infra/ingestion side. Short answers up top: doable, but two points to call out — (A) bulk backfill throughput will determine sliding timeline, (B) vector DB choice will change memory + index formats.

Technical notes / asks:
- Corpus: 3.8M records, average text length ~450 tokens => expected embedding storage ~3.8M * 1.5KB (float16 quant) ≈ 5.7GB — can be compressed further with 8-bit quant.
- Backfill approach (recommended):
  • snapshot export from ACME search service (id, metadata, text)
  • preprocessing & dedupe pipeline in staging (we should validate duplicates count)
  • bulk upsert to vector store using parallel workers (we'll prototype with 32 workers)
  • warm candidate caches / prefix caching before live traffic
  • cutover with traffic split 5/95 -> 25/75 -> 0/100
- Estimated backfill time: with a 32-worker pipeline (each worker ~1200 docs/min) ~ 3–4 hours for ingestion, plus validation & warm-up ~ 6–8 hours. If we need repeatable safe retries, plan for one business day of work.
- Rerank evals: we'll run an initial offline evaluation (NDCG@10, MAP) on their labelled set and then run online A/B for 2 weeks for business metrics. Need at least 300 labelled query examples for stable NDCG signal.

Attachments: ingestion-sla-estimate.xlsx (contains throughput math + cost estimate).

Action items for ACME:
1) Provide a sample export (CSV/JSON) and 300 labelled queries.
2) Confirm vector DB preference and whether they need managed VPC integration.
3) Confirm whether they want us to run embedding generation (we can) or they will provide embeddings.

If privacy constraints require everything to stay in their VPC, we'll schedule a Private deployment runbook.

-Marissa

- We will produce a sample export and 350 labelled queries (we can include both relevance labels and business intent tags). Expect that by EOD Tue 2026-08-25.
- SOC2 evidence: we do need a SOC2 report and a short data flow diagram for security review.

Proposed kickoff: Wed 2026-08-25 11:00 PT works for our team. Please send calendar invite.

Laura
